pages.text: Blood Feathers are dropped by $(l:offsprings/angel)$(c)$(o)Blood Ophanims$() whenever they are killed. Despite what one may expect, these aren't their actual feathers, and are instead a 'manifestation of their nature'. Therefore, only one can be obtained per Ophanim. It is rather fragile, but its divine potential makes it a useful ingredient for various weapons and tools.
